summary: Enforce existing tenant boundary on command status readback (GET /api/v1/operator/commands/{command_id}), persist trusted caller tenant during local evidence admission (CreateConfirmToken), and maintain fail-closed semantics for unscoped legacy records.

incident_context.defect: AC4 tenant isolation violation on generic command status readback: GET /api/v1/operator/commands/{command_id} formerly enforced tenant boundary only for AdvanceLifecycle commands, allowing cross-tenant read of arbitrary operator commands. In addition, normal local evidence admission (CreateConfirmToken) omitted the trusted tenant in audit and trace contexts.
incident_context.root_cause: get_command_status in services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/service.py only checked tenant for CommandType.ADVANCE_LIFECYCLE, and CommandStore._tenant_id_from_command in command_queue.py did not inspect foundation.command_envelope.payload.tenant_id or audit.foundation contexts.
incident_context.resolution: Applied role + trusted tenant + record visibility contract in get_command_status before status projection; updated CommandStore._tenant_id_from_command to resolve tenant from envelope payload and nested audit contexts; persisted verified identity tenant in _persist_local_evidence (CreateConfirmToken) and submit_command_admission using bff_me_tenant_payload normalization (supporting standard string sub and mapping tenant claims without raw stringification); preserved non-disclosing 404 for unknown/invisible/unscoped legacy commands.

acceptance_verification.ac1_reproduced_and_corrected: passed: independent counter reproduction verified prior failure (exit code 1, cross-tenant GET returned 200 exposing tenant-a command to tenant-b); exact final source rerun verified 2 passed, same_tenant 200, other_tenant 404, zero store corruption or owner writes
acceptance_verification.ac2_role_and_tenant_boundary: passed: get_command_status verifies authenticated identity, requires valid read role (403 for unauthorized roles before data exposure), and enforces record_tenant in allowed_tenants (404 non-disclosing for unpermitted tenant, preserving reviewer/admin cross-actor visibility within the same tenant)
acceptance_verification.ac3_trusted_tenant_provenance_and_local_: passed: CommandStore._tenant_id_from_command resolves tenant from foundation.command_envelope.payload.tenant_id; _persist_local_evidence and submit_command_admission store trusted identity tenant in audit.tenant_id, stored_params, and foundation.trace_context using existing bff_me_tenant_payload normalization; client-supplied tenant hints cannot override verified identity
acceptance_verification.ac4_legacy_record_fail_closed: passed: legacy unscoped records (missing tenant provenance) fail closed with 404 (non-disclosing) for all callers including admins; GET remains read-only without mutations or history rewriting
acceptance_verification.ac5_focused_regressions: passed: focused regressions added across all three scoped test modules covering normal POST ack, same-tenant GET 200, different-tenant 404, unauthorized role 403, authorized reviewer/admin other-actor visibility within tenant, AdvanceLifecycle guard, legacy unscoped fail-closed, and local confirmation trusted-tenant save/readback for both string and mapping tenant claims with standard sub
acceptance_verification.ac6_delivery_and_governance: local scope validated/delivery pending: strictly scoped to the 6 declared artifacts with truthful trailers; no infrastructure/SSH/VM/deployment actions; independent reviewer assigned
